title: Tune support vector regression
description: You inspect a scaled regression grid search and its held-out results.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You place StandardScaler before support vector regression, or SVR. The parameter grid fixes the radial-basis-function kernel and varies C, gamma, and epsilon.

steps.question: Which metric selects the best parameter combination?
steps.answer: GridSearchCV uses R-squared with five-fold cross-validation. The later test mean squared error is reported separately.

steps.description: You fit the search on training rows. The recording selects C=50, epsilon=5, gamma=0.01, and the rbf kernel, and reports the cross-validation score.
You predict test rows with the selected estimator. The recording reports test R-squared and mean squared error.
